name: MyChannels
overview: Fork of JPKribs Live Channels with an expanded scheduling model and filler support.
description: MyChannels is a fork of JPKribs' Live Channels plugin, extended with per-entry weight and block size, weighted round-robin scheduling, filler pools for bumpers and trailers, an auto-generated Up Next card, and event-driven cache invalidation. Channels, their guide, and their streams are served in-process through Jellyfin's own Live TV.

versions.changelog: Content Weights UI: switch Weight and Block-size inputs from number spinners to dropdowns (0-10 weight, 1-6 block). Movie/music-video rows now show a disabled Block dropdown so they line up visually with series/collection rows instead of ragging short. Unknown stored values are added as extra options so nothing round-trips wrong.

Full-loop scheduling: each shuffled loop now airs every top-level item's blocks (shorter groups wrap and repeat when they run out). New Series interleave setting: Same keeps the group deal order stable across cycles (TNG, DS9, VOY every cycle); Shuffled reshuffles the order per cycle (TNG, DS9, VOY then DS9, VOY, TNG). Both deterministic — guide and stream agree.

Rework the Content Weights section to use the same jpk-collapsible-section pattern as every other folded section on the channels page. The v1.1.0.0 implementation used a different pattern that didn't wire up correctly against the shared collapsible handler.

Scheduling rewrite. Weight and Block-size are now set per top-level item in the channel (series, movie, collection) rather than as channel-wide FavorKind/EpisodesPerBlock knobs. Editor gains a Content Weights section that lists the resolved items with per-row inputs. FavorKind/FavorStrength/EpisodesPerBlock are deprecated (ignored by the scheduler and hidden from the UI; kept in the model for one release for XML round-trip). A warning is logged on plugin load for any channel that still carries a legacy FavorKind so you can set per-entry weights instead.

Roll back the save-flow visible-progress attempts from v1.0.0.3-1.0.0.5 — none produced visible feedback in the plugin-page context. Restored the upstream green-text-at-end pattern. Kept the two round-trip cuts (in-memory config on channels-tab save, cached RefreshGuide task id).

Replace the save-flow progress feedback with a self-contained top-right toast. The v1.0.0.4 window.Loading approach produced no visible feedback in the plugin page context. Zero dependency on Jellyfin globals now — Save, Import, Delete, etc. show a fixed-position spinner + text that can't be missed, and surface real error messages on failure.

Use Jellyfin's built-in Loading spinner overlay for the save-flow progress feedback. The v1.0.0.3 button-innerHTML approach was invisible in practice (the custom-element polyfill made the swap silently no-op); window.Loading.show/hide is the supported pattern every legacy Jellyfin controller uses.

Save-flow UX pass. Save, Import, Delete, Save Popular, Save Settings, and Rebuild Schedule now disable their trigger button, show a spinner, and surface real success/failure with the error message when things break — no more 5-10 seconds of silent frozen UI. Cached the RefreshGuide task id so save flows skip a task-enumeration round-trip. The channels tab now saves from its in-memory config instead of re-fetching first, cutting another round-trip (trade-off documented in the code: single-admin homelab only).

Fix hardcoded plugin GUID in the config-page JS. Under the fork's new GUID, /Plugins/{id}/Configuration was 404ing because the JS still asked for the upstream GUID; this aligns the JS with the plugin's actual identity.
Add MyChannels as a top-level dashboard sidebar entry (like Intro Skipper and Moonfin). One click from the sidebar instead of digging through Plugins.
Initial fork release. Includes the JS import subpath fix for reverse-proxy deployments; feature work per DESIGN.md follows in subsequent releases.
